exposure: Three maternal age groups: <18 years, 18-19.9 years, and 20-24.9 years
cohort: Women who gave birth in Nigeria between 2003 and 2018, based on data from four Nigeria Demographic and Health Surveys
finding: The study revealed an overall increase in optimal breastfeeding practices in Nigeria across all maternal age groups, though adolescent mothers consistently had lower prevalence of early initiation, exclusive breastfeeding under 6 months, and no prelacteal feed compared to young women.
mod_finding: While mode of delivery was found to be associated with breastfeeding practices, the study did not specifically focus on findings related to mode of delivery.
